_comment: Inputs of python/plots.py: paths relative to the repository. An input is a path or {"file", "label"}; labels are ROOT TLatex. In args, null leaves a background or a gluino mass slot out. The full configuration (all backgrounds, all plots) is in backup/plots.json. See python/hscp/plots.py.

plots.note: QCD, ttbar, ttbar semileptonic, W+jets, data, signal: only QCD as background
W+jets, data, signal: the signal Fpixel only
W+jets, ttbar, QCD, signal: Fpixel quantiles printed in the log
ttbar, W+jets, QCD, signal: the background is QCD only
data and up to three gluino masses: the 1600 one in the first slot (files named ..._1400)
